description: Fetches an existing page's source tree { page, popup, settings, options, cartConfigs } with its name, organization_id and source_version. By default the tree is compacted: boilerplate shared by every element (properties, runtime, empty events/children, per-breakpoint config and factory-default style keys) is stripped, giving the same sparse shape the save tools accept and re-hydrate. compact:false returns the raw stored tree. Requires Webcake credentials.

compact.description: Default TRUE — strip factory-default boilerplate from every element (sparse shape, far fewer tokens). false returns the raw stored tree.

page_id.description: The page id (from list_pages or a URL).

name: get_page
